# has direct reply

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDirectReply`](gmeow-hasDirectReply.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDirectReply>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an annotation or comment to its immediate reply comment. Non-transitive inverse of [`commentParent`](gmeow-commentParent.md). HasReply is the transitive superproperty that reaches the full reply tree.
